p4.behavior: tokens.expected와 graphql_request의 일부 및 profile_window.cases만 옛 테스트가 소비. 새 런타임 모듈·provider override·청크 한계·12개 READ_QUERIES 일치·정렬·live 회복은 P4 계약 테스트로 연결한다.

about: How requests to Facebook are built (appendix A 11-20). Values are Facebook's web-client conventions as observed; derived numbers (jazoest, base64 tokens, unix times) were computed by hand or with the standard library, not by the skill.

tokens.fact: Tokens come from getAsyncParams('POST') in the dedicated page, or CurrentUserInitialData, DTSGInitialData, LSD and SiteData runtime modules. They are never persisted. Fallback jazoest is '2' + the sum of fb_dtsg code points; __rev equals __spin_r.
tokens.missing_token_outcome: getAsyncParams without fb_dtsg triggers the runtime-module fallback; an unavailable fallback token module fails page evaluation before fetch.

graphql_request.fact: A GraphQL read is a POST of a urlencoded form to https://www.facebook.com/api/graphql/ with the browser's cookies.
graphql_request.read_only: Only the read queries named in query_names are ever sent; any other friendly name is refused before a request.

relay_provider_flags.fact: Live .graphql params.providedVariables providers are evaluated with provider.get(); live provider values override caller variables. With only a live id, stored flags fill in. This is not an HTML scan or a constant-value filter.

large_body.fact: The program serializes the whole page result to JSON; over 2 MiB characters it emits ordered {kind: chunk, index, body} lines of at most 512 KiB characters, then {kind: result, chunks, body: ""}. A chunk never splits a surrogate pair.
large_body.case: body = 'a' * 524287 + U+1F600 + 'b' * 9437184: the first chunk is the 524287 'a's, the second starts with U+1F600; joined, the chunks equal the body.

doc_id_discovery.fact: Resolve .graphql params.id and live providers, then _facebookRelayOperation id, then stored id/flags (bundled snapshot is the last fallback). A rejected stored id routes once to its screen with pushState/popstate, 15-second deadline and 2.5-second quiet interval. A rejected live id currently fails with 6; P4 must add verified recovery.

query_names.fact: All 14 read queries (12 from the 2026-10-16 snapshot, the two notifications queries added 2026-10-21); friendly name, response root and cursor variable must match READ_QUERIES. No real ids are copied here. Depth2 has no snapshot id and must be learned.

search_types.fact: args.experience.type selects the vertical; all five share one doc_id.

about_tokens.fact: sectionToken is base64 of app_section:<id>:2327158227; pageID and userID are both the target id; the overview uses collectionToken null and each collection costs one more request.

profile_window.fact: A profile window is sent as afterTime and beforeTime: unix seconds at the start of --since and the end of --until in the local time zone; Facebook filters on the server.
